tahajjud.summary: night namaz offered içinde  last third   night, before Sabah.
tahajjud.why: Allah descends   lowest heaven içinde  last third   night ve asks who will call upon Him.  Prophet ﷺ regularly prayed at night even when isteğe bağlı için him.
tahajjud.benefits: Draws one closer  Allah, softens  heart, ve was  habit   righteous before him.  time when dua dir especially answered.

fajr.summary: dawn namaz —  first   five daily farz prayers.
fajr.why: Allah commanded establishing namaz at  edges   gün; Sabah marks  start   Muslim gün ve was never abandoned by  Prophet ﷺ içinde congregation veya alone.
fajr.benefits: Whoever prays Sabah dir under Allah's protection. It dir witnessed by  angels   night ve gün ve brings açık için  rest   gün.

sunrise.summary: moment  sun rises above  horizon —  time marker, not  namaz itself.
sunrise.why: Namaz dir forbidden while  sun dir rising (ve at zenith ve setting) so  ummah does not resemble sun-worshippers. Knowing sunrise helps time Ishraq ve avoid invalid namaz vakitler.
sunrise.benefits: Observing Allah's signs içinde  sky increases awe (taqwa) ve helps structure  morning sunnah prayers correctly.

ishraq.summary: two-rak'ah sunnah namaz after  sun has fully risen (about 15–20 minutes after sunrise).
ishraq.why: Prophet ﷺ said whoever prays Sabah içinde congregation then sits remembering Allah until sunrise, then prays two rak'ahs, receives  reward   tamamlandı Hac ve 'Umre.
ishraq.benefits: Immense reward ile minimal effort when combined ile Sabah içinde congregation.  peaceful start   gün içinde zikir ve isteğe bağlı namaz.

duha.summary: forenoon namaz — typically two  eight rak'ahs between sunrise ve Öğle.
duha.why: Charity is due on every joint of the body each day; even a few rak'ahs of Duha fulfills that charity for the limbs through worship.
duha.benefits: Forgives sins, brings sustenance (rizq), ve revives  neglected sunnah. Flexible timing makes it accessible when  gün allows.

dhuhr.summary: midday namaz —  second farz namaz, when  sun passes its zenith.
dhuhr.why: five daily prayers were made farz   Night Yolculuk; Öğle breaks  day's busyness ile remembrance  Allah.
dhuhr.benefits: Prophet ﷺ said  first deed judged   Gün  Resurrection dir namaz. Guarding Öğle protects  rest  one's deeds.

asr.summary: afternoon namaz —  middle namaz emphasized içinde  Kur'an.
asr.why: Allah specifically warns about guarding  middle namaz (Salat al-Wusta). It falls when many dir busy veya tired, so preserving it dir  sign  sincerity.
asr.benefits: Whoever misses İkindi, it dir as if he lost his family ve wealth — highlighting its weight. Keeping it strengthens discipline through  gün.

maghrib.summary: sunset namaz — prayed immediately after  sun has ayarla.
maghrib.why: time opens right at sunset; delaying without reason risks missing  preferred window.  Prophet ﷺ warned against neglecting namaz until  sun has ayarla.
maghrib.benefits: Marks gratitude at  day's end ve was among  first prayers  Prophet ﷺ emphasized  his companions.

travel.title: Seyahat ve namaz
travel.subtitle: Qasr, Jam', ve what  Kur'an ve Sünnet teach about salah   yolculuk
travel.takeaway: Allah legislated shortening (Qasr) ve combining (Jam') out  mercy için  traveller — not  abandon namaz, but  ease its performance   road.
travel.obligationsTitle: What siz dir still responsible için
travel.rakatsNote: Only  fard dir shown. Sünnet rawatib ve Vitir dir discussed below — they remain recommended, though many travellers lighten them için hardship.

quran.excerpt: When siz seyahat through  land, there dir no blame  siz if siz shorten  namaz, if siz fear şu those who disbelieve may harm siz. Indeed,  disbelievers dir ever  clear enemy  siz.

hadith.excerpt: Anas said: We travelled ile  Messenger  Allah ﷺ.  mu'adhin called için namaz ve he said: 'Pray two rakahs' — ve he did  same için  other prayers except Akşam (three) ve Sabah (two).
Ibn Abbas said:  Prophet ﷺ combined Öğle ve İkindi, ve Akşam ve Yatsı içinde Madinah without fear veya rain. When asked why, he said: 'He wanted not  burden his Ummah.'

Ya'la ibn Umayyah said: I said  Umar ibn al-Khattab: 'There dir no sin if one shortens  namaz while travelling.' Umar replied: 'I wondered  same, so I asked  Prophet ﷺ ve he said: It dir charity den Allah — accept His charity.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah loves şu His concessions be taken, just as He hates  be disobeyed.'

obligations: five daily prayers remain farz — shortened (Qasr) when siz qualify as  traveller.
Sabah (two rakahs) ve Akşam (three rakahs) dir never shortened.
Siz may combine Öğle ile İkindi, ve Akşam ile Yatsı, when  conditions  seyahat uygula.
Each shortened namaz dir prayed like  first two rakahs   full namaz — recite Al-Fatiha ve  surah, bow, prostrate, then sit için tashahhud ve salam.
When siz return ana sayfa veya intend  settle, resume praying each namaz içinde full at its proper time.
Kaçırıldı prayers while travelling must still be made up (kaza) — seyahat does not waive what was omitted.

qasr.title: Kasr — kısaltma
qasr.body: four-rakah fard prayers — Öğle, İkindi, ve Yatsı — dir prayed as two rakahs   uygun yolculuk. Pray them exactly as  first two rakahs at ana sayfa: standing recitation, one ruku, two sujud, tashahhud, ve salam. Sabah stays two rakahs ve Akşam stays three; neither dir shortened. Qasr applies   fard only.

jam.title: Cem' — birleştirme
jam.body: traveller may combine Öğle ile İkindi into one sitting, ve Akşam ile Yatsı into one sitting — praying both fard prayers geri--geri ile one ezan ve iqamah. Sabah cannot be combined ile any other namaz. Combining dir  separate concession den shortening: siz may shorten without combining, combine without shortening (içinde some situations), veya do both together.

jamTypes.title: Takdim & Te'hir Cem'i
jamTypes.body: Jam' al-Taqdim (early combining): pray both prayers together at  earlier prayer's time — e.g. Öğle ve İkindi at Öğle time. Jam' al-Ta'khir (gecikti combining): pray both at  later prayer's time — e.g. Öğle ve İkindi at İkindi time.  Prophet ﷺ combined at Arafah (Öğle at İkindi time) ve at Muzdalifah (Akşam at Yatsı time), establishing both forms.

when.title: Kolaylıklar ne zaman başlar ve biter
when.body: Concessions begin once siz leave sizin town veya city   yolculuk — not için daily commutes within sizin locality. They end when siz return ana sayfa, veya when siz intend  stay at sizin destination için  period alimler define as 'settling' ( number  gün differs between schools). If siz dir unsure whether siz still say as  traveller, ask  alim before assuming  concessions.

distance.title: Seyahat distance
distance.body: Most alimler require  minimum seyahat distance before Qasr ve Jam' uygula — commonly cited as roughly 80 km (48 miles), veya about two days' yolculuk  foot. Some schools measure den  last buildings  one's city; others use  shorter threshold.  app does not calculate bu için siz — know sizin school's criterion ve uygula it ile  scholar's guidance.

sunnah.title: Sünnet prayers while travelling
sunnah.body: emphasized sunnah prayers (rawatib) before ve after fard remain virtuous but dir not gerekli. Many alimler permit leaving them while travelling due  hardship, especially when combining prayers.  greeting   masjid (tahiyyatul masjid) ve other voluntary prayers remain permissible whenever siz have time ve energy.

witr.title: Vitir   yolculuk
witr.body: Vitir dir sunnah mu'akkadah (strongly emphasized) ve should not be abandoned while travelling. Pray it after Yatsı — even if siz combined Akşam ve Yatsı — as one, three, veya more odd rakahs according  what siz can yönet. If siz fear sleeping before Yatsı while travelling,  Prophet ﷺ permitted praying Vitir earlier after  combined Akşam-Yatsı.

travel.disclaimer: Bu dir eğitim içerik, not  personal fatwa. Distance thresholds, stay duration, combining rules, ve whether Jam' dir limited  need vary between  four schools — consult  qualified alim için sizin yolculuk.

hayd.title: Hayız & ibadet
hayd.subtitle: What  texts teach about menstruation ve daily acts  ibadet
hayd.obligationsTitle: What siz dir still responsible için

hadith.excerpt: Aisha said:  Messenger  Allah ﷺ said  me: 'When sizin menses ends, perform ghusl ve then pray.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Is it not  case şu when one  siz menstruates, she neither prays nor fasts?'

obligations: Do not offer salah while içinde hayız — bu dir Allah's concession, not neglect  ibadet.
Do not oruç during hayız; any kaçırıldı Ramazan fasts must be made up afterward.
Siz may still make zikir, dua, listen  Kur'an, give charity, ve other good deeds.
When hayız ends, perform ghusl ve resume salah ve oruç.

duration.title: Duration  hayız
duration.body:
Hayız dir  regular monthly bleeding most women experience at  familiar time each cycle. Alimler discuss  minimum duration (some say one gün ve night, others require more) ve  maximum duration — commonly cited figures range den about 10  15 gün depending   school  thought.

Practically, note sizin usual pattern (‘ada): how many gün hayız typically lasts ve when it usually begins. If bleeding continues beyond  maximum hayız duration içinde sizin school,  extra gün may be treated as istihada —  rules  namaz ve oruç change once hayız ends, even if bleeding continues.

istihada.title: İstihaze — düzensiz kanama
istihada.body:
Istihada dir bleeding outside  normal hayız period — between cycles, after puberty before  first regular period, veya when bleeding continues past  maximum hayız duration.

Unlike hayız, istihada does not lift  obligation  pray ve oruç.  woman ile istihada generally performs abdest için each namaz while bleeding dir aktif;  bleeding itself does not invalidate abdest according  many alimler.

Distinguishing hayız den istihada can be difficult. Women ile  known cycle often rely  their habit,  time   month, ve  characteristics   blood. If siz dir unsure whether bleeding dir hayız veya istihada, pause farz tracking only when siz dir confident it dir hayız, ve consult  qualified alim için sizin specific case.

nifas.title: Nifas — loğusalık kanaması
nifas.body:
Nifas dir bleeding after childbirth.  same broad rules as hayız uygula: salah ve oruç dir not performed during nifas, ve kaçırıldı Ramazan fasts dir made up afterward — not  prayers.

Maximum duration differs by school; 40 gün dir commonly mentioned. When nifas ends, perform ghusl ve resume tüm ibadet. Nifas ve hayız dir separate categories —  woman may experience both at different vakitler içinde her life.

purity.title: Kanama bittiğinde — ghusl ve devam
purity.body:
When hayız veya nifas ends, perform  full ghusl before resuming salah. Resume oruç only after hayız ends; any Ramazan fasts kaçırıldı during hayız must be made up  other gün.

Namaz kaçırıldı during hayız dir not made up — Allah lifted şu obligation. Bu dir different den hastalık veya seyahat, where kaçırıldı prayers may need kaza. After ghusl, resume sizin normal ibadet ve farz tracking içinde  app.

hayd.disclaimer: Bu dir eğitim guidance, not  personal ruling.  details above vary between schools — consult  qualified female alim if sizin situation dir unclear.

hadith.excerpt: Prophet ﷺ said: 'Pray standing; if siz cannot, then sitting; if siz cannot, then  sizin side.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah has kaldırıldı den my Ummah mistakes, forgetfulness, ve what they dir forced  do.'
Imran ibn Husayn had  painful condition ve prayed sitting.  Prophet ﷺ asked him: 'Can siz stand?' He said no, so  Prophet ﷺ said: 'Then pray sitting; if siz cannot, then lying  sizin side.'

obligations: If siz dir able, pray içinde whatever position siz can — standing, sitting, veya lying down.
Reduce veya omit bowing ve prostration only when siz genuinely cannot perform them.
If siz dir too ill  pray at tüm, şu namaz dir waived — make it up (kaza) when siz recover.
Kaçırıldı Ramazan fasts due  hastalık should be made up when siz dir able.
Siz may still make zikir, dua, read Kur'an, ve give charity.

positions.title: Hastayken namaz — pozisyonlar
positions.body:
varsayılan dir  pray standing ile full ruku ve sujud. If standing causes severe pain, weakness, veya harm, pray sitting — many alimler permit sitting even without standing first when hastalık makes standing genuinely difficult.

If siz cannot sit upright, pray lying  sizin side veya geri, gesturing için ruku ve sujud ile sizin head. Use every position concession before skipping  namaz entirely.

If siz cannot use water için abdest because  hastalık veya risk  harm, perform tayammum when its conditions dir met.

rukuSujud.title: Ruku & sujud ile limited movement
rukuSujud.body:
When siz cannot perform full bowing, incline sizin head için ruku —  deeper incline için sujud. Bu dir  concession used when praying sitting veya lying down.

If siz cannot move sizin head at tüm, alimler differ   minimum movement gerekli — some allow intention alone içinde extreme cases, while others require whatever movement dir physically possible.

Do not omit  entire namaz if siz can pray ile reduced movements.  Prophet ﷺ taught us  use concessions step by step rather than abandoning salah.

unable.title: Tamamlandı inability  pray
unable.body:
If siz lose consciousness, fall into deep sleep through  namaz time, veya dir so severely ill şu siz cannot pray even ile tüm position concessions — ve  entire time için şu namaz passes — şu namaz dir waived ile no sin, but must be made up (kaza) when siz recover.

Marking  gün as excused (hastalık) içinde bu app pauses farz tracking ve holds sizin seri — it does not replace  obligation  make up kaçırıldı prayers later.

Için chronic veya long-term hastalık, öğren  fixed concessions şu uygula  sizin situation den  qualified alim rather than assuming every gün dir fully waived.

fastingQaza.title: Oruç, recovery & make-up (kaza)
fastingQaza.body:
If oruç içinde Ramazan would worsen sizin hastalık veya delay recovery, break  oruç ve make it up  other gün after siz recover —  Kur'an explicitly permits bu için  ill.

Each kaçırıldı Ramazan oruç dir made up ile one gün  oruç later; there dir no kaffarah (expiation) unless  oruç was broken without  valid excuse.

Kaçırıldı salah during hastalık must also be made up içinde order once siz dir able — unlike hayız, where kaçırıldı prayers dir not kaza. When siz recover, resume normal tracking ve work through sizin kaza at  sustainable tempo.

descriptions.newYear: first  Muharram opens  Hicri (kameri) year, whose say begins den  Prophet's migration (Hijrah) den Makkah  Madinah. Muharram dir one   four sacred months ve  Prophet ﷺ called it " month  Allah," naming its voluntary oruç  best after Ramazan (Sahih Muslim 1163). It dir  time  reflect   year past ve renew good intentions. There dir no specific mandated ritual için  gün itself, so beware  unfounded "Yeni Year" practices; increasing voluntary oruç across  month dir  established Sünnet.
descriptions.ashura: 10th  Muharram.  Prophet ﷺ found  Jews  Madinah oruç it içinde gratitude için Allah saving Musa ve  Children  Israel den Pharaoh, ve said, "We have more right  Musa than siz," then fasted it ve told  Muslims  oruç (Sahih al-Bukhari 2004). Oruç Ashura expiates  minor sins   önceki year (Sahih Muslim 1162).  differ den other communities, it dir recommended  also oruç  9th (Tasu'a):  Prophet ﷺ intended  do so  following year (Sahih Muslim 1134). Oruç  9th ve 10th together dir  preferred pratik.
descriptions.mawlid: 12th  Rabi al-Awwal dir widely associated ile  birth   Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ( exact date dir debated among historians). Muslims universally love ve honour him ve dir commanded  send blessings upon him (Kur'an 33:56). Whether  hold  dedicated annual celebration (Mawlid) dir  point  which mainstream alimler differ: many, especially içinde  Sufi ve traditional traditions, permit veya encourage gatherings  remembrance ve sending salawat, while others (notably içinde  Salafi tradition) hold şu  fixed yearly observance was not practised by  early generations ve so should be avoided. Bu app presents  gün neutrally; increasing salawat ve following  Prophet's Sünnet dir agreed goods.
descriptions.isra: Al-Isra wa al-Mi'raj commemorates  Prophet's ﷺ miraculous Night Yolculuk den Makkah  Jerusalem (al-Aqsa) ve his ascension through  heavens, referenced içinde Kur'an 17:1 ve 53.  bu night  five daily prayers were prescribed — originally fifty, then reduced  five by Allah's mercy while their reward remained fifty (Sahih al-Bukhari 349).  night affirms  sanctity  al-Aqsa ve  centrality  Namaz. Its precise date (commonly placed  27 Rajab) dir not firmly established, ve no specific ibadet dir authentically tied   night itself; guarding  five daily prayers dir its lasting lesson.
descriptions.ramadan: ninth month ve  fourth rükün  Islam. Oruç den dawn  sunset dir farz  every capable adult Muslim (Kur'an 2:183–185). It dir  month içinde which  Kur'an was first revealed (Kur'an 2:185).  Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever fasts Ramazan out  faith ve seeking reward will have his past sins forgiven" (Sahih al-Bukhari 38). Nights dir enlivened ile Taraweeh namaz, ve  last ten gün carry Laylat al-Qadr. It dir  month  oruç, Kur'an, charity, ve drawing near  Allah.
descriptions.laylatQadr: Night  Decree — "better than  thousand months" (Kur'an 97:3),  night  Kur'an began  descend. Ibadet  it outweighs  lifetime  over eighty-three years.  Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever stands (içinde namaz)  Laylat al-Qadr out  faith ve seeking reward will have his past sins forgiven" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1901). Its exact night dir hidden; seek it içinde  odd nights   last ten  Ramazan —  21st, 23rd, 25th, 27th, ve 29th (Sahih al-Bukhari 2017), ile  27th especially hoped için. Spend these nights içinde namaz, Kur'an, ve  dua: "Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni."
descriptions.eidFitr: Festival  Breaking  Oruç,   1st  Shawwal, marks  end  Ramazan.  gün begins ile  Eid namaz ve dir preceded by Zekat al-Fitr,  charity given before  namaz so  poor may also rejoice. Muslims recite  takbir, wear their best, exchange greetings, ve strengthen family ve community ties. Oruç dir forbidden  bu gün (Sahih al-Bukhari 1991) — it dir  gün  gratitude ve permitted celebration için  ibadet completed içinde Ramazan.
descriptions.arafah: 9th  Dhul-Hijjah,  greatest gün  Hac, when pilgrims stand içinde ibadet   plain  Arafah — "Hac dir Arafah." It falls within  blessed first ten gün  Dhul-Hijjah, gün içinde which righteous deeds dir more beloved  Allah than any others (Sahih al-Bukhari 969). Için those not  Hac, oruç bu gün dir highly recommended: it expiates  sins   önceki year ve  coming year (Sahih Muslim 1162). Pilgrims themselves do not oruç, so as  have strength için  standing ve supplication.
descriptions.eidAdha: Festival  Sacrifice,   10th  Dhul-Hijjah, dir  greater   two Eids ve coincides ile  culmination  Hac. It commemorates Prophet Ibrahim's willingness  sacrifice his son içinde obedience  Allah, who ransomed him ile  ram (Kur'an 37:100–107). Those able offer  sacrifice (Udhiyah/Qurbani), sharing  meat ile family, neighbours, ve  poor.  gün begins ile  Eid namaz ve takbir ve continues through  three gün  Tashriq. Oruç dir forbidden  bu gün ve  gün  Tashriq (Sahih al-Bukhari 1991).

basics.title: What dir zekat?
basics.body:
Zekat dir  third rükün  Islam, sitting between  namaz (salah) ve  oruç  Ramazan. Içinde  Kur'an  command  establish namaz ve give zekat dir repeated many vakitler as  single pairing — showing şu ibadet  Allah ve care için His creation dir woven together. It dir not  isteğe bağlı gift but  fixed, compulsory right şu  poor hold over  wealth   rich.

 word zekat means both temizlik ve growth. Giving  small, fixed portion  sizin surplus purifies  rest  sizin wealth ve sizin heart den greed, ve — by Allah's promise — causes what remains  grow içinde blessing rather than shrink.

 standard rate  monetary wealth dir one-fortieth, şu dir 2.5%. So için every 1,000  uygun wealth şu has completed its kameri year above  threshold, 25 dir due. Bu dir  modest paylaş by design: enough  circulate resources  those içinde need without straining  giver.

Zekat dir not  same as sadaqah. Sadaqah dir any voluntary charity, given içinde any amount, at any time,  almost anyone. Zekat dir  defined obligation —  ayarla rate,  ayarla categories  wealth, once ayarla conditions dir met, paid  ayarla categories  people. Neglecting it deliberately dir  serious sin; both  Kur'an ve Sünnet warn sternly against hoarding wealth while withholding its due.

purpose.title: Why zekat — purpose & wisdom
purpose.summary: It purifies wealth ve  soul, ve lifts  poor
purpose.body:
Allah says of zakat: "Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them to grow" (Qur'an 9:103). The obligation works on two levels at once — it purifies the giver's soul from stinginess and love of the world, and it purifies the wealth itself so that what stays in your hand is wholesome and blessed.

Socially, zakat is a divinely ordered system of circulation. When the Prophet ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen he instructed that zakat be taken from their rich and given to their poor. Wealth is not meant to pile up among a few; zakat pulls it back into motion so the needy are fed, debtors are freed, and the community's bonds are strengthened.

Spiritually, giving zakat is an act of gratitude and trust. It answers the human urge to hoard with the certainty that provision comes from Allah, and it trains the believer to love giving. The one who pays zakat willingly finds their wealth protected, their heart lightened, and their reward stored with their Lord — "there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve" (Qur'an 2:277).

hawl.title: kameri year (hawl)
hawl.summary: Wealth must stay above nisab için one Hicri year
hawl.body:
Zekat  cash, gold, silver, ve trade wealth dir generally due only after şu wealth has remained at veya above  nisab threshold için one tamamlandı Hicri (kameri) year, known as  hawl.  Prophet ﷺ taught şu there dir no zekat  wealth until  year has passed over it.

Içinde pratik, note  date sizin zakatable wealth first ulaşıldı nisab. Şu date becomes sizin annual zekat anniversary — each year,  şu same Hicri date, siz value everything siz own ve pay 2.5%   toplam.

Siz do not need  takip each coin separately. Most alimler hold şu as long as sizin toplam stays at veya above nisab across  year, small dips ve rises içinde between do not matter — siz simply assess  whole sum  sizin anniversary. If sizin wealth falls entirely below nisab during  year, many alimler consider  hawl  reset, restarting only when siz sonraki reach nisab.

Remember şu  Hicri (kameri) year dir about eleven gün shorter than  solar year. If siz prefer  pay   fixed Gregoryen date için convenience, some alimler permit it provided siz slightly increase  rate  account için  shorter kameri cycle. Agricultural produce ve livestock follow their own timing rules ve dir not tied   hawl içinde  same way.

nisab.title: Nisab —  minimum threshold
nisab.summary: Measured against ~87.5 g gold veya ~595–612 g silver
nisab.body:
Nisab dir  minimum amount  wealth  person must own before zekat becomes farz. Someone whose net wealth stays below nisab tüm year owes no zekat —  obligation dir only  those who have  genuine surplus.

 Prophet ﷺ fixed  thresholds içinde  currency  his time: 20 dinars  gold veya 200 dirhams  silver. Içinde weight bu works out  roughly 85–87.5 g  gold, ve roughly 595–612 g  silver ( small variation reflects different scholarly conversions   dirham). Bu hesaplayıcı uses widely cited figures  about 87.48 g gold ve 612.36 g silver.

Because gold ve silver no longer trade at  ratio they did içinde  Prophet's era,  two thresholds now give very different monetary values —  silver nisab dir far lower. Many contemporary alimler therefore advise measuring cash ve mixed wealth against  silver nisab: it makes more people liable, but şu means more   poor dir helped, which dir  spirit   obligation. Others follow  gold nisab. Both positions dir respected — follow sizin own scholar's guidance.

zakatable.title: What dir generally zakatable
zakatable.summary: Nakit, metaller, yatırımlar, ticaret malları, alacaklar
zakatable.body:
Zekat dir due  wealth şu has  potential  grow — money ve things held as money — rather than  items siz simply use.  main categories agreed upon across  schools dir cash, gold ve silver, trade goods, ve (ile their own rules) crops ve livestock.

Commonly zakatable bugün: cash içinde hand ve içinde bank accounts; gold ve silver, including bullion, coins, ve stored jewellery not içinde regular use; stocks, shares, ve mutual funds valued at their current market price;  merchandise ve inventory   business (trade goods), valued at resale price; strong receivables — loans ve invoices siz reasonably expect  collect; ve rental veya business income siz have kaydedildi rather than spent.

Many alimler also include accessible retirement savings ve cryptocurrencies held as  asset, treating them like cash veya investments. When içinde doubt,  guiding question dir simple: dir bu wealth  store  value veya  means  growth şu I could liquidate? If so, it dir likely zakatable. Value everything at today's market price  sizin zekat date — not at what siz originally paid.

exempt.title: What dir usually not zakatable
exempt.summary: Personal use items, worn jewellery, kilitli pensions
exempt.body:
Wealth tied up içinde sizin ordinary daily life dir generally not zakatable, because zekat hedefler growing wealth, not  things siz live ile ve use. Sizin ana sayfa, sizin car, sizin clothing, furniture, appliances, ve  tools ve equipment  sizin trade dir tüm exempt — however valuable they dir.

Gold ve silver jewellery şu  woman wears regularly dir  well-known point  difference.  Hanafi school holds şu tüm gold ve silver dir zakatable even if worn;  majority — Maliki, Shafi'i, ve Hanbali — exempt jewellery kept için normal personal use but include it if it dir hoarded as  store  wealth veya exceeds customary adornment. Follow  ruling   school siz follow.

Pension veya provident funds siz cannot yet access dir often excluded until  money actually comes into sizin hands, though some alimler require zekat   accessible portion. Debts owed  siz şu dir unlikely ever  be repaid dir usually not counted until recovered. As always,  finer details vary between schools — when  case dir unclear, ask  qualified alim rather than guess.

debts.title: Borçlar & kesintiler
debts.summary: Immediate debts may be deducted önce calculating 2.5%
debts.body:
Zakat is calculated on your net zakatable wealth, so genuine debts you owe can reduce the amount on which you pay. The clearest case is debts due now — an unpaid personal loan, an outstanding credit-card balance, rent or bills already owed. Most scholars allow these to be subtracted from your gross wealth before you apply the 2.5%.

Long-term debts such as a mortgage or a multi-year instalment plan are handled with more care, because deducting the entire balance would wipe out the zakat of almost anyone with a home loan. A common contemporary approach is to deduct only the payments due within the coming year, not the whole outstanding sum. Schools and scholars differ here, so pick a consistent method under guidance.

Two cautions. First, do not treat future or hypothetical expenses as deductible debts — only what you actually owe counts. Second, do not subtract last year's unpaid zakat as if it were an ordinary debt; unpaid zakat remains a due obligation and should simply be paid. When your debt situation is complex, a scholar's ruling is worth more than a rough guess.

recipients.title: Who may receive zekat
recipients.body:
Zakat may only be given to the categories of people Allah Himself named in Surah at-Tawbah (9:60). This is one of the few acts of worship where the recipients are fixed by revelation, not left to the giver's preference. The eight categories are: the poor (al-fuqara); the needy (al-masakin); those employed to collect and administer zakat; those whose hearts are to be reconciled (al-mu'allafah); the freeing of captives and those in bondage (fi'r-riqab); the debt-burdened (al-gharimin); in the cause of Allah (fi sabil Allah); and the stranded traveller (ibn as-sabil).

It is not required to give to all eight; giving your zakat to even one eligible category fulfils the obligation, and directing it to the poor and needy is the most common practice.

Equally important is who may not receive it. Zakat cannot be given to the wealthy, nor to those you are already obliged to support — your parents, your children, or your spouse — since supporting them is a duty you owe anyway. In the classical view it is a personal transfer of ownership to an eligible individual, not a general donation; scholars differ on whether institutions such as masjids or broad public projects qualify under the cause of Allah. It also cannot be given to the family of the Prophet ﷺ, the Banu Hashim, as zakat. Aim it deliberately at people who match the Qur'anic categories.

otherRates.title: Other types  zekat & zekat al-fitr
otherRates.summary: Crops, livestock, ve  pre-Eid zekat al-fitr differ
otherRates.body:
2.5% rate applies  money ve trade wealth — zekat al-mal, which bu hesaplayıcı covers. Several other categories have entirely different rules ve rates.

Crops ve fruit have zekat due at harvest, not after  year:  rate dir 10% (ushr) için land watered naturally by rain veya springs, ve 5% için land irrigated by artificial effort veya cost. Grazing livestock — camels, cattle, sheep, ve goats şu graze freely için most   year — have their own species-by-species nisab counts ve sliding scales, drawn directly den  Sünnet.

Zekat al-fitr dir different again, ve every Muslim should know it. It dir  small, fixed charity — about one sa' (roughly 2.5–3 kg)   staple food such as dates, barley, wheat, veya rice, veya its cash value içinde many rulings — due at  end  Ramazan  behalf  every member   household, young ve old. Its purpose dir  purify  oruç person den any shortfall ve  ensure  poor also have food  celebrate Eid.  Prophet ﷺ commanded şu it be paid before  Eid al-Fitr namaz; paid afterwards it counts only as ordinary charity. Each  these categories has its own detailed rulings — seek guidance specific   asset.

mistakes.title: Common mistakes  avoid
mistakes.summary: Errors şu make zekat invalid veya miscalculated
mistakes.body:
Even sincere Muslims often slip on the practical details of zakat. Knowing the common errors helps you pay correctly and with peace of mind.

Forgetting the hawl or the anniversary: paying at a random time, or skipping years, leaves an outstanding obligation. Fix one Hijri date each year and assess your wealth on it.

Miscounting wealth: valuing gold or shares at their purchase price instead of today's market value, forgetting cash held in multiple accounts or currencies, or overlooking business inventory and money owed to you. Zakat is on everything zakatable that you own on your date.

Giving to the wrong people: handing zakat to parents, children, or a spouse you already support, or treating it as a generic donation to any good cause. It must reach one of the eight Qur'anic categories.

Intention errors: giving generously all year but never intending any of it as zakat. Zakat is an act of worship and needs the intention (niyyah) that this particular payment is your obligatory zakat.

Over-deducting debts: subtracting a whole long-term mortgage, or future expenses that are not yet owed, to shrink the bill. Only real, current liabilities reduce your zakatable wealth. When any of these is unclear for your situation, ask a qualified scholar rather than assume.

currency.title: Currency & rates
currency.body: Zakat is calculated on the market value of your wealth in a currency you understand. Spot gold and silver prices help estimate nisab and metal values — they are indicative, not a substitute for local market rates used by your scholar.

liquid.title: Cash & precious metals
liquid.body: Cash, bank balances, and gold or silver held as wealth are among the clearest zakatable assets. The Prophet ﷺ warned sternly about withholding what is due on gold and silver. Jewellery worn for normal use is a known point of difference between schools — follow your madhhab. You may enter a cash value here, or calculate metals by weight in the next section.

metals.title: Gold & silver by weight
metals.body: Nisab was fixed in the Sunnah by weight: about 20 dinars of gold or 200 dirhams of silver (commonly cited as ~87.5 g gold or ~612 g silver). Karat and purity matter because zakat is on the pure metal content. Live prices are for 24k / fine metal per gram — choose your unit (gram, tola, troy oz) and karat so the calculator converts correctly.

investments.title: Investments & business
investments.body: Trade goods, merchandise, and wealth meant to grow are generally zakatable at today's market value. Shares and funds are commonly valued like trade wealth. Strong receivables you expect to collect are often included. Qur'an 2:267 urges spending from the good of what you have earned — value honestly on your zakat date.

property.title: Land, property & vehicles
property.body: Your personal home, personal car, and ordinary household goods are generally not zakatable — zakat targets growing wealth, not items of use. Plots, houses, or vehicles held for investment, sale, or trade may be included at market value (or amounts already paid on installment investment plots). When unsure, ask a scholar.

livestock.title: Livestock (grazing flocks)
livestock.body: Free-grazing sheep, goats, cattle, and camels have their own Sunnah scales and animal nisab (e.g. 40 sheep, 30 cattle, 5 camels) — not the 2.5% money rate. Due is usually paid in animals of specified age. Fed animals kept as a business often follow trade-goods rules instead. Optional cash values here are only a planning estimate.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & harvest (ushr)
agriculture.body: Zakat on crops is due at harvest, not after a lunar year. The well-known rate is 10% (ushr) when land is watered by rain or springs, and 5% when irrigation costs effort or money. Enter this season's harvest market value and choose the water source that matches your situation.
agriculture.localRefExcerpt: And He is the One Who produces gardens, trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [flavours], and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of their fruit when they bear fruit, and give its due on the day of its harvest…

deductions.title: Deductions
deductions.body: Zakat is on net zakatable wealth. Immediate debts due now are commonly deducted before applying 2.5%. Long-term mortgages are treated more carefully — many contemporary scholars deduct only the coming year's payments, not the whole balance. Living expenses due immediately are allowed only if your scholar permits.

nisab.title: Nisab threshold
nisab.body: Nisab is the minimum surplus before wealth zakat is due. The Prophet ﷺ fixed it at 20 dinars of gold or 200 dirhams of silver, and taught that no zakat is due until a year has passed over the wealth. Because gold and silver prices diverge today, many scholars prefer the lower (often silver) threshold so more of the poor are helped. This calculator suggests the lower of the two live estimates.

history.title: İlk İslam tarihi
history.subtitle: Peygamberimizin ﷺ vefatından Raşidin Halifeliği'nin sonuna kadar
history.disclaimer: 11–41 Hicri (632–661 MS) ile sınırlıdır — Peygamberimizin ﷺ hayatının sonundan Raşidin Halifeliği'nin sonuna kadar. Siyasi ve askeri anlatı klasik tarih eserlerini takip eder; Osman/Ali dönemi, sonraki teolojik anlaşmazlıklara hakemlik etmeden sunulur.

laylatAlQadr.title: Kadir Gecesi
laylatAlQadr.subtitle: Kadir Gecesi — bin aydan daha hayırlıdır
laylatAlQadr.intro: Kadir Gecesi, Ramazan'ın son on gününün tek gecelerinde gizlidir, tek bir tarihe bağlı değildir. Tek bir geceyi tahmin etmek yerine, hepsinde samimi ibadetle onu arayın.
laylatAlQadr.disclaimer: Bu kılavuz, geceyi belirlemek için tek bir sabit takvim tarihini veya halk arasındaki 'işaretleri' onaylamaz — yalnızca Kur'an ve sahih hadisin belirttiklerini esas alır.

eid.title: Bayram kılavuzu
eid.subtitle: Ramazan Bayramı ve Kurban Bayramı — namaz, sünnet ve hükümler
eid.intro: Kur'an ve sahih hadisten iki bayram — bayram namazının nasıl kılınacağı, Fıtır Sadakası, kurban ve günün sünnet uygulamaları.
eid.disclaimer: Eğitim amaçlı genel bakış — fetva değildir. Mezheplerin görüş ayrılığına düştüğü yerlerde (ekstra tekbir sayısı gibi) her iki görüş de sunulur; imamınızı veya yetkin bir yerel alimi takip edin.

ruqyah.title: Rukye
ruqyah.subtitle: Kur'ani ve peygamberî ruhsal şifa
ruqyah.intro: Rukye; şifa ve korunma için Kur'an, Allah'ın isimleri veya sahih peygamber dualarının okunmasıdır — asla namazın veya tıbbi bakımın yerini tutmaz.
ruqyah.disclaimer: Rukye ruhsal bir uygulamadır, tıbbi bir tedavi değildir. Ne yetkin bir doktora görünmenin ne de beş vakit namazın yerini tutar. Ciddi veya sürekli bir sıkıntı için hem bir alime hem de bir sağlık uzmanına danışın.

newMuslim.title: Yeni Müslüman kılavuzu
newMuslim.subtitle: İlk günler ve haftalar için sıcak, pratik bir başlangıç
newMuslim.intro: İslam'a hoş geldiniz. Bu kılavuz; kelime-i şehadeti, beş şartı, iman esaslarını ve namaza ilk bakışı kapsar, ardından sizi bu uygulamadaki daha kapsamlı Namaz, Akide ve Kur'an kılavuzlarına yönlendirir.
newMuslim.disclaimer: Tüm mezheplerin ortak kabul ettiği temel esasları kapsayan basit ama doğru bir başlangıç kılavuzu. Kendi durumunuz için yerel bir imam veya öğretmene sorun.

finance.title: İslami finans
finance.subtitle: Riba, adil ticaret, bağış ve tekafül
finance.intro: İslam'ın paraya getirdiği etik çerçeveye eğitim amaçlı bir giriş — riba yasağı, adil ticaret, zekat ve sadaka, ve tekafül (ortak risk paylaşımı).
finance.disclaimer: Genel eğitim içeriğidir, finansal veya fetva tavsiyesi değildir. Fon tarayıcıları, belirli ürünler ve kendi sözleşmelerinizle ilgili hükümler için yetkin, sertifikalı bir İslami finans alimine veya kuruma danışılmalıdır.
